How to eat better
without going on a diet
Add before you remove. Put vegetables and protein on your plate first. When half the plate is good food, there's less room for the rest.
Cook a few simple meals each week. Rice, eggs, chicken, vegetables, pasta. Home cooking is healthier and cheaper than any takeaway.
Keep good snacks visible. Fruit on the table, nuts in the drawer. You eat what you see first, so make the easy choice the good one.
Drink water with every meal. Many cravings are just thirst. A glass before you eat helps you eat calmly and stop when you're full.
Before: my evenings were snacks and screens. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I snack much less out of boredom.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my evenings were snacks and screens. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I snack much less out of boredom.

slides.texte_overlay: Eat slowly and without your phone. Your body needs time to feel full. Slower meals mean you enjoy food more and eat less.
Allow yourself treats. Pizza with friends, cake on birthdays. Eating well is about most days, not every single bite.
